title: First representative differential as a two-step connecting map
statement: Let C be abelian [def-sp-abelian], and let F be the category of finite filtered cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration]. Suppose boundary inclusions hBZ and isomorphisms eH:Q_1^(p,q)(V) to H^(p+q)(gr^p V) are given for all V, with eH normalized by an epic representative projection z and a graded cycle lift g such that z pi eH=g pi_H [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Fix a finite filtered cochain complex $U$ and a representative differential $D_1$ on its first quotient page [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. For all $p,q$ there is a short exact sequence $\operatorname{gr}^{p+1}U\xrightarrow{i}F^pU/F^{p+2}U\xrightarrow{j}\operatorname{gr}^pU$. Its maps obey $\pi_{p+1,p+2}i=\iota_{p+1,p}\pi_{p,p+2}$ and $\pi_{p,p+2}j=\pi_{p,p+1}$. Under the normalized quotient-homology isomorphisms $e_H$, $D_1^{p,q}e_H^{p+1,q}=e_H^{p,q}\delta_{i,j}^{p+q}$. This only compares the first concrete quotient page with a homology connecting map; it constructs no spectral sequence or exact couple.

source.place: Tag 012K, Lemma 12.24.3(1), boundary map of the two-step quotient sequence

proof.text: Apply Mathlib kernelCokernelCompSequence.snakeInput to the inclusions F^(p+2) -> F^(p+1) -> F^p. The cokernel row is exact; its first map is mono since the second inclusion has zero kernel, and its last map is epic. The cokernel map identities give both projection squares. Integer index transport is performed in the auxiliary filtered_quotient_sequence lemma before choosing the maps.

Use the proved simultaneous differential-representatives cover to obtain t,t',x,y with x epic. The source differential lies in F^(p+1), and the target differential is zero by d squared = 0, so t and t' factor through the corresponding cycle representative subobjects. The supplied hH lifts define graded cycles cx,cy. Mono cancellation extends each hH normalization equation to these arbitrary representatives.

Project t to F^p/F^(p+2). Both projection squares and the chain map equations identify its image in gr^p with cx and its differential with the inclusion of cy. Apply Mathlib ShortComplex.ShortExact.δ_eq' to obtain cx pi_H δ = cy pi_H. The representative equation of D and the two normalization equations identify both sides after precomposition by x followed by the boundary cokernel projection. This composite is epic, so cancel it.
